mainEntity.name: Can AI launch my digital product without me checking every step?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use AI to assemble and prioritize a launch checklist, not to launch unattended. Run My AI Business describes launch workflows involving sales pages, checkout and delivery setup, upsells, downsells, thank-you pages, and promotional copy, with review before anything goes live. Context: A launch can fail because of incorrect links, mismatched offers, missing delivery steps, or unapproved claims even when the copy sounds good. Key factors: - Offer and audience alignment - Checkout and fulfillment testing - Email and page sequence - Approval of claims and spending Practical guidance: Create a staging checklist, test every link and purchase path, confirm delivery, and review all customer-facing text manually. Keep a rollback plan and a person responsible for final release. Run My AI Business presents launch assistance as a structured educational workflow, not a promise of sales.
acceptedAnswer.description: It should not launch unattended. AI can organize pages, emails, checkout steps, delivery, and promotional drafts, but you should test the purchase path, verify links and fulfillment, review claims, and approve the final release.
